messages:
olivia: spotting spike in GPU attach failures in ap-southeast1 starting 05:02 UTC. nvme I/O errors and short remounts. looks like cleaner jobs overlapped with batch window.
opsbot: ALERT: nvme_io_errors > 18 on gn-apse1-41 at 05:03:12 UTC. scrub-scheduler v1.3.1 recently rolled.
raj: pulling dmesg + iostat. early pattern: repeated 'nvme0: timeout' followed by 'device error - media'. temps show micro-spikes to ~75C for 8-16s before timeouts. SMART: Reallocated_Sector_Ct incremented on two hosts.
megan: paste dmesg snippet?
olivia: dmesg:
```
[05:03:05] nvme0: I/O timeout, qid=6
[05:03:06] nvme0: device error - media error
[05:03:07] EXT4-fs (nvme0n1): Remounting filesystem read-only
[05:03:07] blk_update_request: I/O error, dev nvme0n1, sector 22446688
```
zhao: thermal + smart bumps -> likely media stressed by concurrent IO. options: 1) throttle cleaner concurrency (CLEANER_PAR=1), 2) add jitter to scrub cron, 3) temporarily repel GPU batch pods from nodes with SMART warnings.
raj: I can flip CLEANER_PAR via helm values for region: `helm -n infra upgrade cleaner infra/cleaner --set region=ap-southeast1,cleaner.concurrency=1 --reuse-values` will roll. propose canary to 6 nodes first.
megan: also add random_jitter=45s to scrub configmap and reduce frequency to 0.8x. small change but avoids alignment.
olivia: do it. and cordon the 6 canary nodes for batch jobs until we verify. command for cordon: `kubectl cordon gn-apse1-{41..46}` (we'll do one by one).
opsbot: ACTION: helm upgrade triggered (canary nodes=6) at 05:09 UTC.
raj: executing canary patch now. will monitor attach_rate, nvme_io_errors, and SMART counters.
megan: monitoring iostat and attach success. if error rate drops >50% on canary within 12m, we roll region-wide. otherwise prepare kernel-nvme-retry backport plan.
zhao: note: backport reduces media->controller escalation but requires single-host reboots for DKMS module. that is a heavier lift.
olivia: agreed. prioritize lighter changes first. update ops channel and mute noisy nvme alerts but keep a trimmed 5-host alert.
raj: canary rolled to 6 nodes at 05:12 UTC. initial 6m check: attach failures on canary down from 9/min to 3/min, SMART increments stopped. good signal.
megan: great. rolling to full region in 20m if trend persists. I'll schedule a gradual rollout with 30s pause between batches to avoid alignment.
olivia: thanks team. ping @raj and @megan if things spike again. I'll open a brief follow-up doc for postmortem actions (scrub cadence review, thermal alerting thresholds). :thumbsup:
